MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Replace drinking water

2. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Melody.

3. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   D. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.

5. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Dance.
   C. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Dance.

6. Best practice when working on Singing Games: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Singing Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Singing Games.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Singing Games.
   D. Damage equipment used for Singing Games.

7. Best practice when working on Elements of Music RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   B. Practise Elements of Music RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   D. Damage equipment used for Elements of Music RESPONDING.

8. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Black, white, and grey

10. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the volume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the costume

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Elements of Music RESPONDING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Singing Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. D — Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
